items.title: The effectiveness of instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization on pain and function in patients with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis - BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) found that instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) significantly improved pain (SMD -0.74; 95% CI -1.04 to -0.44) and function (SMD -0.66; 95% CI -0.99 to -0.34) in musculoskeletal disorders in the short term, with moderate effect sizes.
items.curatedReason: IASTM 对肌肉骨骼疾病的疼痛和功能确有短期改善，效果中等。这项纳入了14项RCTs、共550名患者的系统综述和荟萃分析，证实了 IASTM 可作为有效的辅助手段，但它并非解决所有问题的银弹，长期疗效尚无定论。
items.titleZh: 器械辅助软组织松动术对肌肉骨骼疾病患者疼痛和功能的有效性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项随机对照试验（n=550）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）在短期内显著改善了肌肉骨骼疾病患者的疼痛（SMD -0.74；95% CI -1.04 至 -0.44）和功能（SMD -0.66；95% CI -0.99 至 -0.34），效应量中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: IASTM does offer short-term, moderate improvements in pain and function for musculoskeletal disorders. This systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) confirms IASTM's role as an effective adjunct, but it's not a panacea, and its long-term efficacy remains undetermined.
items.limitation: 研究的异质性较高，且大多数纳入研究缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity, and most included studies lack long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Minimal Important Changes in Accelerometer-Measured Physical Activity and Sedentary Time in Older Patients With Subacute Stroke: A Multicenter Study.
items.summary: A multicenter observational study involving 299 subacute stroke patients estimated the minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured sedentary behavior, light-intensity physical activity, and moderate-to-vigorous intensity physical activity, ranging from 11.4 to 34.2 minutes, based on improvements in FIM scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究首次给出了亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变（MIC），为临床评估康复效果和设定目标提供了量化依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变：一项多中心研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 299 名亚急性卒中患者的多中心观察性研究估计了加速计测量的久坐行为、轻度身体活动和中高强度身体活动的最小重要改变（MIC），范围为 11.4 至 34.2 分钟，为康复效果评估提供了量化参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study provides the first estimates of minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured physical activity and sedentary time in older patients with subacute stroke, offering quantitative benchmarks for assessing rehabilitation effectiveness and setting treatment goals.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，依赖自我报告的锚点进行MIC估计。
items.limitationEn: The study's observational design relies on self-reported anchors for MIC estimation.

items.title: Feasibility, content and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale for chronic stroke survivors.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study with 66 chronic stroke survivors (median 81 years old, 76 months post-onset) confirmed the feasibility, content validity, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) using COSMIN standards, with high completion rates and good correlation to other functional measures.
items.curatedReason: 本研究证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）对慢性卒中幸存者的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，为你评估该群体功能受限的个体化目标提供了一个可靠工具。它解决了在慢性卒中语境下 PSFS 应用的痛点。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者患者特异性功能量表的可行性、内容效度和结构效度。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 66 名慢性卒中幸存者（中位年龄 81 岁，发病后 76 个月）的横断面研究，依据 COSMIN 标准证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，表现出高完成率和与其他功能测量工具的良好相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the feasibility, content, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) for chronic stroke survivors, providing a reliable tool for assessing individualized functional goals in this population. It addresses a key gap in PSFS application within chronic stroke contexts.
items.limitation: 研究人群年龄偏大，样本量相对有限，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study population was older, and the sample size was relatively limited, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Navigating recovery after flap repair for pressure injury in spinal cord injury/disorder: lived experience and clinician perspectives on complications, resilience, and care models.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the lived experiences of 8 individuals with SCI/D experiencing post-flap complications and 10 multidisciplinary clinicians, revealing themes of shifting realities, motivation through community, and the need for comprehensive, integrated care models in pressure injury recovery.
items.curatedReason: 对于SCI/D患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复，我们仍需更全面的整合照护模式。这项研究从8位患者和10位临床医生的经验中发现，除了生理挑战，患者面临的心理和社会现实转变、社群支持的激励作用同样不可忽视。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤/疾病患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复的探究：并发症、韧性和护理模式的患者与临床医生视角。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 8 名经历皮瓣修复并发症的脊髓损伤患者和 10 名多学科临床医生的经验，揭示了压疮恢复中现实转变、社区驱动的动力以及对全面综合护理模式的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: For SCI/D patients recovering from pressure injury flap repair, a more comprehensive, integrated care model is still needed. This study, drawing from the experiences of 8 patients and 10 clinicians, highlights that beyond physiological challenges, the psychological and social shifts patients face, and the motivating role of community support, are equally critical.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study with a small sample size, the generalizability of its findings is limited.

items.title: Co-design of a physical activity maintenance intervention for adults with stroke.
items.summary: A mixed-methods co-design study, involving 38 stakeholders in focus groups and 11 in workshops, developed a physical activity maintenance program for stroke survivors, identifying themes like shifting realities of PA post-stroke and motivation through community.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过共同设计方法，为卒中患者在社区康复后维持身体活动提供了干预方案的框架。它强调了将患者、照护者和临床医生纳入设计的重要性，未来有望转化为更符合实际需求的临床工具。
items.titleZh: 卒中成人身体活动维持干预的共同设计。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法共同设计研究，通过焦点小组（38 名参与者）和工作坊（11 名参与者）为卒中幸存者开发了身体活动维持计划，识别了卒中后身体活动的现实转变和社区驱动的动力等主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study provides a framework for physical activity maintenance interventions in stroke survivors post-community rehabilitation, highlighting the importance of involving patients, caregivers, and clinicians. This could lead to more clinically relevant tools in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为方案设计阶段，尚未进行干预实施与效果评估。
items.limitationEn: This study is in the intervention design phase; implementation and effectiveness evaluation are pending.

items.title: Fatigue in Neurological Rehabilitation: Why Brain Diversity and Population Diversity Matter.
items.summary: A commentary discusses the limitations in neurological fatigue research, noting that 95%-100% of studies rely on questionnaires and peripheral biomarkers, with fewer than 15% using functional neuroimaging, and highlights a lack of population diversity in cohorts.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评批判性地指出了神经康复领域对疲劳研究中“大脑多样性”和“人群多样性”的不足，提醒你关注评估工具的局限性及研究对象地域和族裔的代表性，以更好地理解和干预疲劳。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的疲劳：为什么大脑多样性和人群多样性至关重要。
items.summaryZh: 一篇述评探讨了神经疲劳研究的局限性，指出 95%-100% 的研究依赖问卷和外周生物标志物，功能神经影像学应用不足 15%，并强调了研究人群多样性的缺失。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically highlights deficiencies in "brain diversity" and "population diversity" in neurological rehabilitation fatigue research, urging you to consider the limitations of assessment tools and the representativeness of study populations for better understanding and intervention of fatigue.

items.title: Eight Functional outcomes, two dimensions: a cross-sectional analysis of scale dependence in spatiotemporal gait determinants after subacute stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 244 subacute stroke patients found that eight routinely used gait outcomes primarily represent two dimensions. Spatiotemporal gait parameters were analyzed to determine how determinants differ between these outcomes, suggesting some outcomes reflect similar constructs despite scale differences.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了亚急性卒中患者八种常用功能结局量表（如 BBS、步速、TUG）在评估步态时存在重叠和维度差异，这提示你在选择和解释步态结局指标时，要考虑量表间的关联性，避免重复评估。
items.titleZh: 八种功能结局，两个维度：亚急性卒中后时空步态决定因素的量表依赖性横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 244 名亚急性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，八种常用的步态结局指标主要代表两个维度。分析了时空步态参数以确定不同结局指标的决定因素差异，表明尽管量表不同，部分结局反映了相似的结构。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals overlaps and dimensional differences among eight commonly used functional outcome measures (e.g., BBS, gait velocity, TUG) for gait assessment in subacute stroke. This suggests that you should consider the interrelations between scales when selecting and interpreting gait outcome measures to avoid redundant assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法评估结局量表随时间的动态变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design and cannot assess dynamic changes in outcome measures over time.

items.title: Implementing an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in oldest-old nursing home residents: protocol for a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial (SCOPE Study)
items.summary: This article presents the protocol for the SCOPE Study, a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial designed to implement an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, aiming to provide evidence for effective strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案描述了一个针对最老年住院养老院居民的肌少症干预措施，未来有望为这群高危人群的运动处方提供实证依据。目前阶段，它提示你关注肌少症在养老院的干预潜力。
items.titleZh: 针对最老年养老院居民肌少症运动干预的实施方案：一项实用性整群随机对照试验（SCOPE 研究）方案。
items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了 SCOPE 研究方案，这是一项旨在针对最老年养老院居民实施肌少症运动干预的实用性整群随机对照试验，旨在为有效策略提供证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol describes an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, which could provide evidence for exercise prescriptions in this high-risk population. At this stage, it highlights the potential for sarcopenia interventions in nursing homes.

items.title: REINA: A Recognize-Then-Infer Wearable-to-App AI Framework for Breast Cancer Rehabilitation
items.summary: The REINA AI framework uses wearable IMU data for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation, recognizing activities and inferring EMG signals for neuromuscular assessment.
items.curatedReason: REINA这个利用可穿戴设备的AI框架，通过推断神经肌肉活动来远程监测乳腺癌康复患者的运动功能，这听起来很吸引人。但作为临床实践，在广泛应用前，我们必须进一步验证其临床实用性及其在不同患者群体中的有效性。
items.titleZh: REINA：一种用于乳腺癌康复的识别-推断可穿戴设备到应用程序 AI 框架
items.summaryZh: REINA AI 框架利用可穿戴 IMU 数据对乳腺癌康复中的运动功能进行远程监测，识别活动并推断肌电信号以进行神经肌肉评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: REINA, a novel AI framework utilizing wearables, shows promise for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation by inferring neuromuscular activity. While this is an interesting technological advancement, its clinical utility and validation in diverse patient populations require further investigation before widespread adoption.
items.limitation: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.
items.limitationEn: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.

items.title: Tailoring Resistance Exercise for Knee Osteoarthritis: An Intervention Systematic Review With Dose-Response Meta-analysis of the Effects of Intensity and Volume.
items.summary: A systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of RCTs found dose-response relationships between isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume and outcomes of pain, function, and strength in people with knee osteoarthritis (OA), and compared different intensities and delivery methods.
items.curatedReason: 膝骨关节炎患者的下肢等张阻力训练，其容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间存在明确的剂量-反应关系。你可以根据这篇高质量系统综述的发现，更精准地调整患者的康复方案，包括训练强度和交付方式。
items.titleZh: 针对膝骨关节炎的个体化阻力训练：一项关于强度和容量效应的剂量-反应荟萃分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验进行的系统综述和剂量-反应荟萃分析，旨在评估膝骨关节炎患者等张下肢阻力训练的容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间的剂量-反应关系，并比较不同强度和实施方式的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee OA patients, isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume shows clear dose-response relationships with improvements in pain, function, and strength. Leverage this high-quality systematic review to fine-tune your rehabilitation protocols, including training intensity and delivery methods, for better patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 该综述未明确报告膝骨关节炎阻力训练的最佳长期剂量。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly report on the optimal long-term dosage for resistance training in knee osteoarthritis.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: The Efficacy of Exercise Therapy for Nonspecific Chronic Low Back Pain According to the FITT Principle: A Systematic Review With Meta-analyses.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analyses evaluated the efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, differing in frequency, intensity, type, and time (FITT), on disability in individuals with nonspecific chronic low back pain (LBP).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述及其荟萃分析，基于 FITT 原则，精细评估了不同运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的疗效。这为你调整慢性腰痛患者的运动处方提供了具体的证据指导，让你能更精准地优化干预参数。
items.titleZh: 基于 FITT 原则的运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛疗效的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了根据 FITT（频率、强度、类型、时间）原则调整的运动疗法，对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, specifically their FITT parameters (frequency, intensity, type, and time), for disability in nonspecific chronic low back pain patients has been systematically evaluated. This review offers concrete evidence to help you optimize exercise prescription parameters and more precisely manage these patients.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的异质性可能影响了 FITT 各组成部分特定推荐的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity among included studies may impact the precision of specific recommendations for each FITT component.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: APTA Analysis Reveals Greater Long-Term Payment Gains in Medicare Proposal
items.summary: APTA's analysis suggests that the latest Medicare payment proposal could lead to greater long-term payment gains for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: APTA 的分析显示 Medicare 最新提案可能带来物理治疗师长期支付的增长。这直接影响您未来的报销收入，务必关注后续的具体政策细节和影响。
items.titleZh: APTA 分析揭示 Medicare 提案中长期支付增长潜力
items.summaryZh: APTA 的分析显示，Medicare 最新提案可能为物理治疗师带来更大的长期支付增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's analysis indicates that the latest Medicare proposal may lead to long-term payment increases for physical therapists. This directly impacts your future reimbursement revenue, so pay close attention to subsequent policy details and their implications.

items.title: Exploring animal-assisted therapy in stroke rehabilitation: a systematic review of emerging evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of 12 studies on animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in adult stroke rehabilitation found emerging evidence primarily for psychosocial and emotional benefits, with limited data on motor or cognitive outcomes due to varied study designs and small sample sizes.
items.curatedReason: 动物辅助疗法在卒中康复中的证据仍然有限且异质性高，尚不能支持作为常规干预。目前主要提示在心理社会和情感层面有潜在益处，但在运动或认知功能上尚无定论。继续以研究和辅助手段视角关注，别急于写入常规康复方案。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中动物辅助疗法：系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对12项研究的系统综述显示，动物辅助疗法在成人卒中康复中主要在新兴的心理社会和情感益处方面有初步证据，但由于研究设计多样和样本量小，在运动或认知结局方面数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in stroke rehabilitation remains limited and highly heterogeneous, not yet supporting its routine integration. Current findings primarily suggest potential benefits in psychosocial and emotional domains, with no definitive conclusions on motor or cognitive functions. Continue to view AAT as an area of research and an adjunctive approach, rather than integrating it into standard rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（12项），且设计多样、样本量小，限制了证据的综合性和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The small number of included studies (12), coupled with diverse designs and small sample sizes, limits the generalizability and synthesis of the evidence.

items.title: Association of the time from injury to surgery with postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study explored the association between the time from injury to surgery and the risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折的老年患者，受伤到手术的等待时间，可能影响他们术后发生急性心脑血管事件的风险。作为康复治疗师，这意味着你需要更积极地与多学科团队协作，推动患者在允许的情况下尽快手术，这间接支持了术前优化干预的必要性。
items.titleZh: 髋部骨折老年患者受伤至手术时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究探讨了髋部骨折老年患者从受伤到手术的时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件风险之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older patients with hip fracture, the time from injury to surgery might influence their risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events. As therapists, this implies a need for more proactive collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advocate for prompt surgery when medically appropriate, indirectly supporting the necessity of pre-operative optimization.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究可能存在混杂因素和信息偏差，且因果关系难以确定。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective cohort studies may be subject to confounding factors and information bias, and causal relationships are difficult to establish.

items.title: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study found that Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training combined with physical therapy improved spatiotemporal gait parameters and overall gait quality in 52 children with cerebral palsy across different GMFCS levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，Lokomat 机器人步态训练结合物理治疗能改善脑瘫儿童的步态质量，尤其是对于不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿。这为临床实践中机器人辅助疗法的使用提供了进一步证据。
items.titleZh: Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗对脑瘫儿童步态质量的影响：一项按严重程度分层的分析
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究发现，52 名脑瘫儿童在接受 Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗后，其步态时空参数和整体步态质量均有所改善，且治疗效果在不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿中有所体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study indicates that Lokomat-based robotic gait training combined with physical therapy can improve gait quality in children with cerebral palsy, including those with varying motor impairment severities. This provides further evidence for the use of robotic-assisted therapy in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，存在固有的局限性，如数据缺失和无法控制的混杂因素，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, it has inherent limitations such as missing data and uncontrolled confounding factors, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.
